listings.title: Cull the Quarry-Track Wolves
listings.task: Hunt and cull 4 gray wolves denning along the old quarry track east of Ashbridge before they pull down a cart horse on the haul road.
listings.desired_end_state: 4 gray wolves of the quarry-track pack are slain and carts travel the haul road without attack.

objectives.where: old quarry track east of Ashbridge

listings.title: Cull the Millpond Snappers
listings.task: Hunt and kill 2 large snapping turtles that have been snatching ducklings and nipping waders at the Ashbridge millpond.
listings.desired_end_state: Both snapping turtles troubling the millpond are killed and the miller's ducks and waders are safe again.

listings.title: Cull the Vineyard Boar
listings.task: Hunt and kill 1 tusked old boar that has been breaking into the Tallows Vineyard rows each night and flattening the harvest.
listings.desired_end_state: The tusked boar raiding the Tallows Vineyard is killed and the vine rows are no longer torn up at night.

listings.title: Cull the Reedsnake Brood
listings.task: Hunt and cull 3 marsh serpents of the Reedsnake brood that have been striking eel-fishers among the reed beds south of Ashbridge.
listings.desired_end_state: 3 marsh serpents of the Reedsnake brood are slain and the eel-fishers work the reed beds without attack.

listings.title: Clear Mossback Warrens, Level 1
listings.task: Clear level 1 of Mossback Warrens: push through the mossy hill's upper tunnels off the old quarry track and drive out or slay the goblin scouts and warriors holding them. Beware: goblins fight in numbers and a shaman is said to lurk deeper ÔÇö do not press past level 1.
listings.desired_end_state: Level 1 of Mossback Warrens is cleared of its goblin scouts and warriors.

objectives.what: goblin scouts and warriors of Mossback Warrens

listings.title: Thin the Millpond Snappers
listings.client: Alder Mill, east bank of the Ashbridge millpond
listings.task: Hunt and cull 4 of the snapping terrapins infesting the millpond sluice so the mill wheel can be cleared and repaired.
listings.desired_end_state: 4 snapping terrapins are culled at the millpond sluice and the mill wheel can be cleared and repaired.

objectives.where: the millpond sluice east of Ashbridge

listings.title: Quarry Track Wolves
listings.task: Hunt and cull 5 of the wolf pack that has been pulling down cart-horses along the old quarry track east of Ashbridge.
listings.desired_end_state: 5 wolves of the quarry track pack are culled and cart-horse losses along the track stop.

objectives.what: wolves of the quarry track pack
objectives.where: the old quarry track east of Ashbridge

listings.title: Wasps in the Orchard Walls
listings.task: Hunt and cull 6 of the giant wall-wasps nesting in the old orchard boundary walls before harvest picking begins.
listings.desired_end_state: 6 giant wall-wasps are culled from the orchard boundary walls and harvest picking can begin safely.

objectives.where: the Pommel Row orchard boundary walls

listings.title: The Boar of Tanner's Gully
listings.task: Hunt and kill the great scarred boar that has gored two tanners and torn open the soaking pits in Tanner's Gully.
listings.desired_end_state: The great scarred boar of Tanner's Gully is killed and the soaking pits are safe to work again.

listings.title: Clear Mossback Warrens, Level 1
listings.task: Clear level 1 of the Mossback Warrens ÔÇö the mossy hill's upper goblin tunnels off the old quarry track ÔÇö of its goblin scouts and warriors. Expect a fighting withdrawal to be hard: the tunnels are cramped, the goblins defend their palisades in numbers, and a shaman is said to keep deeper down; do not press past level 1.
listings.desired_end_state: Level 1 of the Mossback Warrens is cleared of its goblin scouts and warriors.

objectives.what: goblin scouts and warriors of the Mossback Warrens
